headline: Castellanos' 10th-inning sac fly walks off the Twins
recap: The Phillies beat the Minnesota Twins 2-1 in 10 innings at Citizens Bank Park. The bottom of the 10th opened with Harrison Bader, the automatic extra-inning runner, on second base. Weston Wilson's sacrifice bunt moved Bader to third, and Nick Castellanos followed with a sacrifice fly to center field that scored Bader for the walk-off win, the second out of the inning.

Cristopher Sanchez started for Philadelphia and allowed no runs over 5 2/3 innings, striking out eight without a walk. Minnesota's Simeon Woods Richardson matched him, working six scoreless innings with nine strikeouts and no walks of his own.

The Twins broke through first in the sixth, when Austin Martin walked and scored on a Ryan Jeffers double. Max Kepler tied it for the Phillies in the eighth with a solo home run, his 18th of the season, setting up the extra-inning finish.
